features.label: PDAC Approved L0637
features.text: Designed for lumbar-sacral support, providing sagittal and coronal motion restriction to aid in recovery.

features.label: One-Size Adjustable Fit
features.text: The Sure Slot sizing system allows for quick, tool-free adjustments, fitting waist sizes 26-60 inches, expandable up to 70 inches with an extension panel.

features.label: Superior Motion Restriction
features.text: Rigid anterior, posterior, and lateral panels provide additional spinal stability and support for post-operative care and chronic pain relief.

features.label: Multiple Back Panel Options
features.text: Removable back panel extension allows for customized support, adapting as recovery progresses.

features.label: Step-Down Recovery Support
features.text: Easily transitions to the Aspen Vista 631 LSO LoPro Back Brace and Aspen Vista 627 Lumbar Back Brace for continued recovery.

measurement: The Aspen Vista 637 LSO Back Brace is one-size adjustable, fitting waist sizes 26-60 inches, with the option to expand up to 70 inches with an extension panel. For expert fitting guidance, visit our Perfect Fit Promise page.
